description: This file contains the implementation of the MainActivity class for an Android application, including lifecycle methods, UI setup, and logging initialization.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class for the application, responsible for UI setup, fragment management, and logging initialization.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created, sets the content view, and adds a fragment if not already added.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu options in the activity.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain involving LogWrapper, MessageOnlyLogFilter, and LogFragment for on-screen debug output.
